description: Reads a subject's full profile out of a deep report (no standalone GET /subjects/{id} exists upstream, so the input is a deepReportId, not a subject id). Returns the subject as structured JSON — any atomic field (e.g. date of birth via `subject.birthDate`) can be extracted from it directly.

deepReportId.description: Deep report id whose subject to read (no standalone GET /subjects/{id} exists upstream)

name: smi_get_subject
title: Get Subject
